title: Short routine meeting with consent items only
subtitle: Quarterly tenders report and Council tracking list received; next committee meeting set for February 11, 2025.
overview: The Administration and Finance Committee held a brief first meeting of 2025 on January 14. Regional Chair K. Redman presided because the committee chair was unable to attend. There were no presentations, delegations, declarations of pecuniary interest or other business.

The committee dealt only with routine matters. It reconvened in open session {{vote:m1}} and then approved the Consent Agenda {{vote:m2}}. The consent item was the quarterly summary of tenders, quotations and requests for proposals approved by the Chief Administrative Officer (COR-TRY-25-003), which was received for information. No one asked for it to be removed for discussion.

The committee also received the Council and Committee tracking list for information. For residents, the meeting made no new policy or spending recommendations. The report shows how purchasing approvals were handled by staff. The meeting adjourned {{vote:m3}}, and the next Administration and Finance meeting is scheduled for February 11, 2025.

decisions.detail: The committee received report COR-TRY-25-003, a summary of tenders, quotations and requests for proposals approved by the Chief Administrative Officer, for information as part of the Consent Agenda {{vote:m2}}.

debate: No delegations appeared, and no items were pulled from the Consent Agenda for discussion.
The chair noted that questions on consent items would only be taken if an item was requested for removal. None was.
No questions or comments were raised on the Council and Committee tracking list, and there was no other business.
